desc: Prove that the minimum number of erase operations equals the number of consecutive runs in the set of distinct values.
Derive and verify the right-endpoint last-occurrence formula and its \(O(N)\) update rule.
Produce the final Python implementation with safe accumulation and input/output handling.
Check boundary cases, including \(x=1\), repeated occurrences, nested intervals, all-equal sequences, and strictly increasing sequences.
